skill.summary: Monitor trading bot health by detecting stalls, verifying LIVE status and data freshness, restarting safely if needed, and summarizing status clearly.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of tradebot-ops.

- Monitors trading bot health and detects operational stalls.
- Validates bot state (LIVE/halting), data freshness, and signal updates.
- Provides concise human-readable health summaries.
- Automates safe restarts and stale state recovery actions.
- Ensures safety by never auto-increasing risk and preferring self-heal.
